name: Kaveri Physiotherapy & Rehab Centre
notes: Post-operative and orthopaedic physiotherapy, home visits for elderly, stroke and knee-surgery recovery, gait training.

name: SteadyStep Home Physio
notes: At-home physiotherapy for seniors who cannot travel, mobility and balance training after surgery.

name: MobiCare Wheelchair & Equipment Rental
notes: Monthly rental of wheelchairs, walkers, hospital beds and commodes, free delivery within 5km.

name: EasyMove Mobility Rentals
notes: Foldable wheelchairs and walking aids on weekly or monthly rent, budget-friendly for short recovery.

name: Amma Home Nursing Services
notes: Trained attendants and nurses for bedridden and elderly patients, wound care, injections, day and night shifts.

name: CarePlus Elder Nursing
notes: 12 and 24 hour home nursing for elders, post-hospitalisation care, catheter and feeding-tube management.

name: Anbu Old Age Day Care
notes: Daytime care centre for seniors, meals, physiotherapy, companionship and supervised activities, monthly fee.

name: Silver Years Assisted Living
notes: Residential assisted-living for seniors needing daily support, nursing on call, monthly package.

name: Tamil Nadu Senior Citizen Pension Cell
notes: Free help applying for the old-age pension scheme, document assistance, no charge for below-poverty applicants.

name: SahaYog Scheme Assistance
notes: Help enrolling elders in government welfare and pension schemes, paperwork and follow-up, nominal service fee.

name: Arogya Medical Loan Aid
notes: Guidance and low-interest medical loans for treatment and surgery, counselling on hospital-bill support schemes.

name: Amudham Home Tiffin for Elders
notes: Home-cooked soft diabetic-friendly meals delivered daily to seniors, monthly subscription, low-salt options.

name: Grandma's Kitchen Meal Delivery
notes: Daily South-Indian meals for elderly living alone, customisable for health conditions, monthly plan.

name: QuickBasket Grocery Delivery
notes: Doorstep grocery and medicine delivery, senior-priority slots, small per-order delivery fee.

name: Chennai 24x7 Ambulance Network
notes: Basic and cardiac ambulance on call across Chennai, wheelchair-accessible vans, per-trip charge.

name: SeniorRide Elder Cab
notes: Cabs with trained drivers to take elders to hospital appointments, wheelchair-friendly, per-trip.

name: HealthFirst Home Diagnostics
notes: Home blood-sample collection and lab tests for elders, reports online, sample-collection fee.

name: MediHome Pharmacy Delivery
notes: Free home delivery of prescription medicines, monthly refill reminders for chronic patients.

name: Manam Elder Counselling
notes: Counselling for elderly loneliness, depression and caregiver stress, in-person and phone sessions.

name: Vetri Stroke Rehabilitation Unit
notes: Structured rehabilitation for stroke and paralysis, physiotherapy plus speech and occupational therapy, per session.
